name: Council's Judgment
clause: Starting with you, each player votes for a nonland permanent you don't control. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.

The existing `vote` op takes a FIXED list of labelled option/effect pairs written into the script, so a vote whose options are the objects on the battlefield right now — and whose consequence acts on the winners — cannot be expressed at all.
